author: Burningtaco_224
body:
Disclaimer:this was actually going to be a reply on the actual thread but it wont let me post the reply because it was too big or some shit.

i agree with the idea of us needing constructive criticism. and with that criticism we can make a big overhaul. First off I do agree with what people say about the staff while most are nice there a re a few bad staff members .I suggest a background check on each staff member and if they are found to be abusing their power that goes outside the rules they are to be permanently banned from being able to be a staff member. Another thing is expand the server count of people to 750 and keep it there until there are more people that want to play then the amount of people that the server can contain. The extra 250 spaces would be for some extra growing room if we reach an average of 500 a day once again. I also recommend looking at games from other servers and if they garnet a decent among of people implement them into avicus and do away with games that relieve little to no players and reintroduce them if enough interest is shown in them. I also think that a more proper punishment system is in place first it's a automatic warning and then if they are caught doing the same thing within a period of time after the warning they get a temp can for a day then if the refusal to comply with the rules continues with the same player they get a bigger temp ban and finally if they continue to disobey the rules they get a perm ban. I also believe there there should be swearing allowed but to a certain extent. Slurs such as racial or homophobic in nature should not be permitted. But for certain people if they swear to an excessive level there should be a filter in place. Words like shit,fuck, etc should be allowed but to a certain extend. if the swearing is out of rage let them do it to unleash their anger about dying or the like. but if the swearing is profusely directed at others then it should be filtered. "this is taking to fucking long i cant wait for this to end" or "God dammit i died" that should be allowed. but this "fuck you XX_hgerfwfrere_XX you took my shit (you killed me) (you hacking bastard)" that shouldn't be allowed.

replies.author: NolanDalton
replies.body:
If Avicus runs off a VPS (server with an OS like Linux pre-installed) then the Minecraft server software is installed manually, meaning that there is no set limit for player slots.

Hosting companies who have the software pre-installed (MCProHosting, HostHorde, BeastNode, etc.) charge based off of RAM and/or player slots, because you only have access to the Minecraft part of it, not the rest of the OS.

I'm assuming Kylo runs it off of a VPS as it would give him more options.
